turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You can use -ed to talk about finished actions.
Example: Yesterday I walked to school. The walking is finished, so I add -ed.
Rule: for a finished action, add -ed to a regular verb.
Right: She painted a picture on Monday. Wrong: She paint a picture on Monday.
Now you try. Write the verb open in the past: Yesterday the teacher ___ the window. (write one word)
